title: Great Pyramid built over hundreds of years, not in Khufu's 23-year reign

tellings.quote: More likely it's a it's a project that took hundreds of years to complete uh

plain: The Great Pyramid of Giza was not built in the 23 years that the pharaoh Khufu reigned, but was more likely a project that took hundreds of years to finish. A researcher named Graham Hancock says this without naming a source, and he mentions the writer Robert Bauval alongside it. If true, the pyramid would be the work of many generations, and the usual story of who built it and when would have to change.
